description: [Momentum Factor] Twenty-trading-day close-price momentum. It measures the cumulative return from day t-20 through day t using adjusted close prices. The fixed lookback is 20 trading days, and the value is missing when either required close is unavailable or the lagged close is zero.
variables_json: {"C_{i,t-20}": "Adjusted $close price of instrument i exactly 20 trading observations before day t.", "C_{i,t}": "Adjusted $close price of instrument i on day t from daily_pv.h5.", "lookback": "Fixed at 20 trading days within each instrument."}

description: [Reversal Factor] Negative five-trading-day close-price return. Higher values identify instruments with weaker recent performance and test short-term reversal. The fixed lookback is 5 trading days, and the value is missing when either required close is unavailable or the lagged close is zero.
variables_json: {"C_{i,t-5}": "Adjusted $close price of instrument i exactly 5 trading observations before day t.", "C_{i,t}": "Adjusted $close price of instrument i on day t from daily_pv.h5.", "lookback": "Fixed at 5 trading days within each instrument."}

description: [Low-Volatility Factor] Negative rolling volatility of 20 consecutive close-to-close returns ending on day t. Higher values represent lower realized volatility. The calculation requires all 20 returns, corresponding to 21 valid adjusted closes from t-20 through t, and uses sample standard deviation with ddof=1.
variables_json: {"C_{i,s}": "Adjusted $close price of instrument i on trading day s from daily_pv.h5.", "bar r_{i,t}^{(20)}": "Arithmetic mean of the 20 daily returns from s=t-19 through s=t.", "minimum_periods": "20 valid returns are required; otherwise the factor is missing.", "r_{i,s}": "One-trading-day close-to-close simple return of instrument i on day s.", "standard_deviation": "Sample standard deviation with ddof=1.", "window": "Exactly 20 consecutive daily returns ending on day t."}

description: [Volume Surprise Factor] Current-day volume relative to the mean volume over the preceding 20 trading days. The historical baseline excludes day t, preventing current volume from diluting its own surprise. Exactly 20 valid lagged volume observations are required, and the value is missing if the baseline mean is zero.
variables_json: {"V_{i,t-k}": "$volume of instrument i k trading observations before day t.", "V_{i,t}": "$volume of instrument i on day t from daily_pv.h5.", "baseline_window": "Exactly 20 prior trading days, from t-20 through t-1; current day t is excluded.", "minimum_periods": "20 valid prior volume observations plus valid current-day volume are required.", "zero_denominator_rule": "Set the factor to missing when the 20-day historical mean volume equals zero."}

description: [Intraday Buying-Pressure Factor] One-day close-location value measuring where the adjusted close lies within the day's adjusted high-low range. Values near 1 indicate a close near the high, while values near -1 indicate a close near the low. The lookback is one trading day, and the factor is missing when the daily range is zero.
variables_json: {"C_{i,t}": "Adjusted $close price of instrument i on day t from daily_pv.h5.", "H_{i,t}": "Adjusted $high price of instrument i on day t from daily_pv.h5.", "L_{i,t}": "Adjusted $low price of instrument i on day t from daily_pv.h5.", "lookback": "Current trading day only.", "zero_range_rule": "Set the factor to missing when $high equals $low."}
